Bash(1 <<'EOF'
WITH ranked AS \(
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    company_name,
    COUNT\(*\) as buy_count,
    COUNT\(DISTINCT trader_name\) as insiders,
    AVG\(price_per_share\) as avg_price,
    COALESCE\(SUM\(value\), 0\) as total_value
  FROM insider_trades
  WHERE filed_date BETWEEN '2025-11-04' AND '2025-12-04'
    AND trade_type IN \('BUY', 'PURCHASE', 'P'\)
  GROUP BY ticker, company_name
\),
scored AS \(
  SELECT 
    ticker,
    company_name,
    buy_count,
    insiders,
    avg_price,
    total_value,
    \(buy_count * 10 + insiders * 15\) as score
  FROM ranked
  ORDER BY score DESC
  LIMIT 10
\)
INSERT INTO ranking_snapshots \(snapshot_date, ticker, company_name, rank, score, avg_buy_price, net_buying, unique_insiders, recommendation\)
SELECT 
  '2025-12-04'::date,
  ticker,
  company_name,
  ROW_NUMBER\(\) OVER \(ORDER BY score DESC\)::int,
  score::int,
  COALESCE\(avg_price, 0\)::numeric\(10,2\),
  COALESCE\(total_value, 0\)::numeric\(15,2\),
  insiders::int,
  CASE WHEN score >= 70 THEN 'STRONG_BUY' WHEN score >= 50 THEN 'BUY' ELSE 'HOLD' END
FROM scored;
EOF)
